name: Batik painting

seo.title: Batik Painting Class Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Batik painting on Koh Lanta: morning or afternoon course, or kayak and paint. Hotel transfer and your finished canvas included. From 1,500 THB for adults.

lead: Paint your own batik canvas with a local instructor, in the morning or the afternoon, or pair it with a kayak trip to the sea cave of Koh Talabeng.
promise: Paint your own batik canvas with a local instructor

facts.label: Kayak and painting
facts.value: Full day. Pickup 08:00–09:00, Koh Talabeng by longtail and kayak, painting from 13:00, back 17:00

facts.label: Your canvas
facts.value: Varnished and delivered the next day

options.label: Private course, your group only
options.note: For a private course, for your group only, ask us.

steps.label: Morning
steps.text: Pickup at 08:00 to 09:00. Introduction to batik at 09:00, then you create your artwork from 10:00 to 12:00. Back at your hotel around 13:00.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Pickup at 12:00 to 13:00. Introduction at 13:00, then you create your artwork from 14:00 to 16:00. Back at your hotel by 17:00.

steps.label: Kayak
steps.text: Pickup at 08:00 to 09:00 for Thung Yee Peng pier. A longtail to Koh Talabeng, paddling around the islets, the sea cave and the beach. Lunch at the mangrove restaurant at 12:00, painting from 13:00, back at your hotel at 17:00.

included: Your finished canvas, delivered the next day after varnishing

faq.a: Yes. Children from 3 to 10 have their own rate.

faq.q: When do I get my painting?
faq.a: The day after the class, once it has been varnished.
Morning or afternoon if you only want to paint. Kayak and painting if you want a day out with the sea cave first.

legacyText.title: Batik Painting Class Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Batik is a wax-resist technique from Java, recognised by UNESCO in 2009. You draw patterns in wax on fabric before it is coloured. An experienced instructor shows you the tools, the colours and the technique, then you paint what you like.
The canvas is varnished after the class and delivered to you the next day.
legacyText.cardDescription: Paint your own batik canvas with a local instructor, or add a kayak trip to the sea cave.
goodToKnow: Children from 3 to 10 pay the child rate.
Times are approximate and can change with the tide and the weather.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. For a private course, for your group only, ask us.
